findings.title: OrderService is a 2729 LOC god-class with 34 functions (22 public + 12 private)

responsibilities_mixed: list / userOrder / deliveredOrder / deliveryBoyOrder paginated read paths (5 listers)
myOrderStore / posOrderStore / tableOrderStore (3 creators, ~600 LOC each)

findings.rationale: PricingService already extracted (decomposed into TaxCalculator/DiscountCalculator/CompositionSnapshotBuilder helpers — exemplary). Same decomposition pattern should be applied to OrderService: e.g. OrderListService, OrderCreateService (POS/Frontend/Table sub-strategies), OrderTransitionService, OrderReportingService. Current god-class encodes 8 distinct responsibilities; any frozen-zone audit boundary becomes a single-file 2729 LOC blob.
findings.remediation_proposal: V1.0.2 backlog — extract OrderListService + OrderTransitionService first (lowest blast radius, mirrors PricingService split). Defer creator split (myOrderStore/posOrderStore/tableOrderStore) to V1.1 because each has its own idempotency lock + transaction nesting that test debt would explode.

findings.title: OrderStateMachine `apply()` adoption is partial — header comment self-documents drift

evidence.verbatim_quote: "Existing OrderService / FrontendOrderService call sites keep their historical pattern (`$order->status = $next; save(); recordTransition(...)`) to honour the frozen zone V1 rule. The `apply()` method is the path forward."
evidence.callsites_using_OrderStateMachine_apply: ZERO (per grep — file's apply() method is unused in production code paths)

findings.rationale: Domain layer has the right abstraction (`apply()` does guard + mutate + audit atomically), but every production callsite still hand-rolls the historic 3-line pattern. This is benign at V1 — the OrderStateMachine::allows() guard still fires before each manual mutation — but undermines the architectural promise of a `Domain/` layer. New code added in 13-zone wave (2026-05-19) still followed the legacy pattern.
findings.remediation_proposal: V1.0.2 backlog — migrate ONE callsite (KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService:291, lowest blast radius) to OrderStateMachine::apply() as proof-of-pattern. Then chip away one callsite per release.

findings.title: 8 admin controllers directly invoke Eloquent ::query() / ::where() (113 occurrences) — layering leak concentrated in 3 reporting controllers

concentration.app/Http/Controllers/Admin/PosCategoryCo: Direct join on item_branch_availability with branch_id where-clause

findings.rationale: Read-only reporting controllers (CashOverview, StockRuptureDashboard, CashSessionReport) host significant SQL/Eloquent logic that should sit in a ReportService. Mutation controllers correctly delegate to Services. The leak is concentrated in reporting/dashboard surfaces — same as the 'flat /Services with no /Repositories' pattern below (B3-ARCH-005). NOT a security issue: BranchScope global scope still applies, and explicit `branch_id` filters add a second fence.
findings.remediation_proposal: V1.0.2 backlog — extract CashOverviewReportService + StockRuptureDashboardService. Keep controllers as 30-50 LOC thin orchestrators returning JSON. This is the same pattern that already exists in 'app/Services/Stock/' but is unused by these controllers.

findings.title: Only 2 interfaces + 2 abstracts in app/Services/ — concrete-class DI is the norm, mocking friction is real

abstracts: app/Services/PaymentAbstract.php (27 LOC, base for payment gateway implementations)
concrete_di_examples: PricingService::__construct(TaxCalculator, DiscountCalculator, AvailabilityService, CompositionSnapshotBuilder, ComposerProfileProjection, ChoiceAvailabilityResolver) — all concrete, all `private readonly` with sensible defaults

findings.rationale: This is INFO not a finding-to-fix. Laravel idiom is concrete-class DI via auto-resolved containers — abstracting every collaborator behind an interface would inflate the 152-service tree without test benefit (the project uses Pest/PHPUnit with real DB + transaction rollback, not mock-heavy unit tests). The 2 interfaces that DO exist are exactly where polymorphism matters (Hardware printer Null vs TCP swap-out; Idempotency repo with planned Redis vs DB backends). Architectural choice, not drift.

findings.title: app/Repositories/ directory does not exist — Repository pattern is intentionally absent

evidence.find_count: find app/Repositories -name '*.php' → 0 files (directory does not exist)
evidence.the_one_repo_that_exists: app/Services/Idempotency/IdempotencyKeyRepository.php — lives under Services, not Repositories. The 'Repository' suffix is for HTTP-cache idempotency record store, not the general DDD Repository pattern.

findings.rationale: Eloquent Models ARE the repository in this codebase (active record). BranchScope global scope adds the multi-tenant fence at model level. Adding a Repository layer would force a second mapping layer with no business benefit and would dilute BranchScope coverage (the global-scope sentinel currently covers 20 models — Repositories would proliferate untested ::query() callsites). Architectural choice, not drift. INFO for synthesis context.

findings.title: Authorization layering is consistent: route `permission:*` middleware + FormRequest::authorize() — zero Gate::/->authorize() in Admin controllers

evidence.route_permission_middleware: Confirmed in routes/api.php — permission:catalog.compose, permission:catalog.publish, permission:customers_show|waiters_show|delivery-boys_show|chefs_show|administrators_show|employees_show, permission:ingredients_manage
evidence.formrequest_authorize_baseline: 83 FormRequests with authorize() method, 65 currently return true (per CLAUDE.md §9 sentinel baseline 66, drifting down via chip-away)
evidence.sentinel_protection: FormRequestAuthzDriftSentinelTest — count GROWS = CI fails. Currently ratcheting DOWN — exemplary.

findings.rationale: Three-layer enforcement (Sanctum auth:sanctum → route permission:* gate → FormRequest::authorize per-payload check) is correctly orchestrated. No god-controller dispatching to Gate::authorize manually. INFO confirms cross-cutting concern is GREEN.

findings.title: Outbox pattern is consistently applied: 26+ domain events use DispatchableAfterCommit + Persist*ToOutbox listener-first ordering enforced

dispatchable_after_commit_users: OrderCreated, OrderStatusChanged, OrderPaidAtCounter, OrderPaymentStatusChanged, OrderCanceled, RefundCreated, OrderTableChanged (order pipeline)
CatalogChanged, ItemCreated, ItemDeleted, CategoryCreated, CategoryUpdated, CategoryDeleted, ComposerProfileChanged, ComposerProfilePublished, StockLevelChanged (catalog pipeline)
evidence.non_dispatchable_after_commit_events: 12 events — all Send*Order*Notification + SendResetPassword + SendSmsCode + OutboxBroadcastSwallowedEvent (notification side-effects + the alarm event itself — none need transactional gating)
evidence.listener_ordering_doctrine: EventServiceProvider.php:144-149 + :171-186 — Persist*ToOutbox listeners declared FIRST in $listen array so a downstream FCM/loyalty/stock-release crash cannot silently re-open the broadcast hole (sync dispatcher halts on listener throw). HEAL-PLAN-D.3 / RED-Z8 P2-2 documented inline.

findings.rationale: This is the V1 outbox SSOT pattern working as designed. Cross-referenced with C6-multi-tab-echo.json: single `private-branch.{id}` channel + per-event `broadcastAs` opt-in + DB-anchored outbox row = cross-pollution structurally impossible. INFO confirms event-driven backbone is GREEN.

frozen_zone_meta_scores.rationale_note: Score 1-5 = 'frozen for good architectural reason'. 5 = NF525/security invariant violation = legal exposure. 4 = production-validated UI, regression risk on payment flow. 3 = owner-protected legacy, no architectural justification but social contract honoured. 1-2 = unfreeze candidate. META-analysis only, NOT a proposal to unfreeze.

resources/js/components/admin/pos/Paymen.rationale: POS payment flow drives multi-tranche split + cash-drawer trigger + fiscal_sequence_no allocation chain. Visual regression here = direct NF525 cash-trail exposure. Owner explicitly marked V1 untouched (CLAUDE.md §7 + BRAIN §2).

resources/js/components/admin/pos/v5/Pos.rationale: Single-tranche payment line UI — touches multi-tranche split logic + amount validation. Frozen per BRAIN §2 V1 untouched. Modification here = same exposure surface as PaymentComponent.

resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/K.rationale: 3104 LOC composition builder — drives kiosk cart contract + composer profile snapshot which is sent to PricingService as ITEM_ID+OPTION_IDS only. Architectural risk: contract mismatch with backend snapshot builder. Production-validated by extensive E2E coverage; not NF525-direct but regression here breaks the kiosk→backend SSOT contract.

Kiosk shell + Echo subscription + cart state machine. Direct broadcast handler bindings (per C6 evidence). Risk: untested event-name binding change silently breaks real-time sync. Owner gate is justified.
Upsell rules drive cart augmentation BEFORE PricingService receives the request. Mis-augmentation = wrong fiscal total. Lower size than KioskWizard but same contract surface.

public/js/pos-wizard.js.rationale: Owner-protected 'design parfait' Vanilla JS hand-written wizard (non-Mix compiled). Architecturally fragile (5964 LOC monolith with no module boundaries, ~296 KB), zero unit tests possible due to DOM-globals coupling, but social contract: owner marked it untouchable. Score 3 (not 5) because no NF525/security invariant lives here — it's a UI shell calling /api/admin/pos/* endpoints. Score 3 (not 1) because owner gate is explicit and re-build cost is high.

public/css/pos-wizard.css.rationale: Companion stylesheet — same social-contract status as pos-wizard.js. Architecturally a legacy artifact, but breaking the visual contract has owner gate. Score 3 honest.

resources/views/admin-pos-v4.blade.php.rationale: Blade entry that loads pos-wizard.js via <script src>. Architectural justification = the social contract on pos-wizard.js extends here. No NF525 logic in this Blade.

app/Services/Fiscal/FiscalSequenceServic.rationale: 115 LOC + 2 public methods. Crystal-clear single responsibility (allocate monotonic fiscal_sequence_no per branch). Cache::lock + DB lockForUpdate + UNIQUE index = triple defense. Any modification = direct NF525 anti-fraud-VAT exposure. Architecturally tight, frozen for hard legal reason. EXEMPLARY.

app/Services/Fiscal/ZReportService.php.rationale: Daily Z-report close + HMAC chain signing. NF525 6-year retention dependency. Cache::lock(z_report_b{n}) serialization. Same legal-exposure class as FiscalSequenceService.

app/Services/Fiscal/AuditLogService.php.rationale: Audit-chain HMAC SHA-256 writer with prev_hash → current_hash chain. Cache::lock(audit_chain_b{n}) cross-worker serialization. Any modification = chain break = legal exposure. Production-validated by chain-validity checks in every audit cycle (bit-identical hash checks).

migrations audit_logs + z_reports trigge.rationale: DB-level BEFORE DELETE trigger raising SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' on MySQL. TRUNCATE bypass mitigated via REVOKE (Ansible CVP0-1, commit f840c3ef5). Modifying these = direct fiscal-evidence destruction surface.

app/Models/Scopes/BranchScope.php.rationale: Global scope drives multi-tenant fence on 20 models (baseline locked by BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest). Modification here = mass-cross-branch-leak risk = security incident class. Architecturally the single most load-bearing 30-line file in the codebase.

app/Http/Middleware/IdempotencyKeyMiddle.rationale: Drives duplicate-POST protection on 28 mutation routes (cash-drawer open/close, refund-with-counter-entry, change-status × 6, kiosk paid order confirm, loyalty redeem). Production boot guard refuses to boot if IDEMPOTENCY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED != true. Modification = direct double-charge / double-drawer-open / double-status-change exposure.

app/Services/Pricing/PricingService.php.rationale: SSOT for pricing. NF525-adjacent (composition_snapshot frozen at order creation). Already cleanly decomposed (TaxCalculator + DiscountCalculator + CompositionSnapshotBuilder) — frozen-zone status protects the SSOT property, not the decomposition. EXEMPLARY architecture + critical SSOT.

app/Domain/Order/OrderStateMachine.php.rationale: Order status transition SSOT (drives KDS bump + POS shortcuts + OSS allowlist). allows() guard fires on every transition. Modification = breaks KDS/POS/OSS sync contract. Note B3-ARCH-002 architectural drift (apply() vs recordTransition-only adoption) does NOT affect this score — the file IS critical, adoption-pattern-of-its-method is separately tracked.

summary.verdict: All 16 frozen-zone items justified architecturally. Three items (pos-wizard.js + pos-wizard.css + admin-pos-v4.blade.php) sit at score 3 (social contract, not architectural necessity) — owner gate is honoured, no proposal to unfreeze. Zero candidates at score ≤2.
